description: Calibration report for one model, computed from its resolved predictions recorded on the ledger: Brier score, expected calibration error (ECE), reliability bins with Wilson score intervals, overconfidence measures and drift over time. Free. Returns not_found when the model has no resolved predictions.

model.description: Model identifier to report on, exactly as recorded on the ledger (e.g. 'jev-1.14.0').

task_type.description: Optional task category filter; omit to aggregate the model's resolved predictions across all task types.

name: court_model_report
title: Model Calibration Report
